batch_metadata.description: Advanced procedural documentation, systems theory, and archival preservation manuals.

books.title: Advanced Protocols for Inter-Library Exchange
books.author: The Ivory Desk Collective
books.summary: A technical guide detailing the handshaking procedures between the Hanno Memorial and satellite branches. It outlines the priority queuing system for high-demand vellum transfers across the network.
books.notes: Standard reference for the ILL Service implementation.

books.title: The Chemistry of Ivory Preservation
books.author: Dr. T. Tuskerman
books.summary: A manual on the chemical stabilization of carved ivory bindings. It focuses on humidity control and the prevention of micro-cracking in the unique atmospheric conditions of the Lower Stacks.
books.notes: Tuskerman was the lead conservator during the Great Humidification of 1960.

books.title: Pruett's Guide to the Lower Stacks
books.author: H.L. Pruett
books.summary: The definitive manual for navigating the sub-basement levels using the Pruett Classification System. It provides the coordinate mapping required for retrieving restricted Founding Age manuscripts.
books.notes: Contains the only authorized map of the 'Silent Wing'.

books.title: Infrasonic Signal Processing in Archival Spaces
books.author: M. Pachworth
books.summary: A technical study on how low-frequency vibrations from the herd affect the structural integrity of the Archive's foundations. It proposes a dampening system based on seismic resonance patterns.
books.notes: Bridges the gap between Pachworth's systems theory and Footfall's acoustic ontology.

books.title: Standardized Metadata for Pachydon Records
books.author: Office of Records
books.summary: The official handbook for cataloging non-textual artifacts, including tusk engravings and seismic recordings. It establishes the mandatory field requirements for the 20th-century digital transition.
